method: Hand review of design/parity/evidence/<row>/comparison.png (reference, built, pixelmatch diff) against Material Design 3 component anatomy and the checked-in reference.

primitives.finding: Tiles are now the reference four (Health score, Breached, Needs work, Healthy) in order; the breach tile states its figure is unknown rather than showing a count (repaired 2026-09-01).
Cards stack in one column with the reference header anatomy (tonal glyph circle, title over blurb, count pill, chevron); expanded cards list entry rows with a Fix action (repaired 2026-09-01).
Built keeps a 'Database reports' headline, a 'Detailed reports' route to the legacy report dialogs and a findings category filter the reference lacks; search and Export stay.

defects.summary: Header controls not in the reference (headline, Detailed reports, category filter)
